units: metres, Z up, front -Y, pivot at footprint centre on the ground; foundations reach Z = -0.3

conventions.lods: one FBX per mesh: Empty <name> exported as an FBX LodGroup (fbx_type) with children <name>_LOD0..3 (LOD3 = hull); sockets are SOCKET_<Kind>_<n> empties parented to LOD0
conventions.vertex_color: Col, linear: R soot/burn (0 clean .. 1 charred), G ground occlusion on walls, B and A 1
conventions.facade_M: R: 0 on walls, per-window random rank (0.15..1] on glass; lit if M.R > 1 - LitFraction. G: culture-tint mask. B: unused
